flags.message: The snapshot records an August 14 Brief for the Federal Respondents and September 1 reply, but the provisioned document manifest contains only the petition and QP. I retrieved those exact pre-decision PDFs from their snapshot links. The response materially changes the forecast: it requests a hold for McNutt and says the government no longer advances the commerce-power theory here. This gap was repaired for this prediction; no outcome or subsequent history was retrieved. Consider coverage of federal responses not titled brief in opposition.
